module: Manager of multiseat game modes (split screen). It loads the gameplay/discover/multiseat/*Rules.lua providers, collects their info via the onGetMultiseatGamemodeInfos hook, starts/stops/restarts a mode, handles the fade, the blocking of input actions, the waiting for vehicles, and the start and end screens (via ui_router and mission.control). A modder adding a multiseat mode goes through it: it calls ext.start(settings), ext.onReady(vehicles), ext.stop(), buildStartScreen, buildEndScreen.
notes: start() fails (false) if the mode is unknown, has no extensionPath, or if more players than playerCount.max have joined.

Switching vehicles in the 'running' phase (outside synchronization) restarts the mode; the vehicleSwitching and walkingMode actions always stay blocked, the others only if the restrictScenarios setting is active.
startScreenPendingOnPauseExit is never set to true in this file: playPendingRound therefore always returns false and isStartScreenPending always false.
After VEHICLE_READY_TIMEOUT (5 s), the mode continues even if the vehicles are not ready.

getPlayerName.desc: Display name of the local player with the given index, based on the joined participant's persona.

requestGamemodeData.desc: Sends the UI (guihooks OnGamemodeData, context 'multiseat') the list of available modes, the current mode, its settings and the list of players. Modes that are mapUnsupported or exceed the number of players are counted but not listed.

showEndScreen.desc: Shows the end screen: emits onMultiseatGamemodeFinished, pauses the simulation time, then builds the screen from resultData and the mode's buildEndScreen overrides (header, headerColor, body, layout, pages, buttons). By default: Replay, Freeroam, Main menu buttons.

resultData.desc: Fields read: title, tied, winnerPlayer (index), text.

stop.desc: Stops the current mode, calls ext.stop() and reactivates multiseat freeroam (ui_multiseat_freeroam.activate).

setReadyCallback.desc: Sets a function called once, when the mode enters the 'running' phase (notifyReady).

deferReady.desc: Moves the phase from 'starting' to 'waiting': the mode announces that it will itself notify when it is ready with notifyReady.

notifyReady.desc: Moves to the 'running' phase, ends the fade if active and runs the callback set by setReadyCallback. Has no effect outside the 'starting'/'waiting' phases.

getVehiclePool.desc: Returns info.vehiclePool of the current mode.

returns.desc: Vehicle pool declared by the mode.

shouldAssignVehiclePool.desc: Indicates whether the start was requested with options.assignVehiclePool = true.

returns.desc: true if the pool must be assigned.

start.desc: Starts a mode: loads ui_multiseat_freeroam, stops the previous mode, loads the mode's extension (info.extensionPath), assigns it ext.info, stores the settings (info.settings defaults if nil), disables multiseat freeroam then launches the mode (with fade unless options.withFade == false).

returns.desc: true if the launch is started, false on error.

restart.desc: Restarts the mode (the current one if name is nil) with fade. If the requested mode is not the active mode, calls start.

settings.desc: New settings; nil = keep the current ones.

returns.desc: false if there is no mode to restart.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether a mode is running.

returns.desc: true if a mode is active.

getMaxPlayers.desc: Maximum number of players of the current mode (info.playerCount.max).

isStartScreenPending.desc: Indicates whether the start screen is waiting for the pause to end (the variable is never set to true in this file).

playPendingRound.desc: Shows the start screen if it was pending.

returns.desc: true if the screen was shown.

onScreenFadeState.desc: Screen fade hook: when state is 1 (black screen) and a launch is deferred, launches the mode.

onPreRender.desc: Called every frame. In the 'waiting' phase with vehicles pending: waits for them to be ready (or the 5 s timeout), notifies ready, calls ext.onReady(vehicles), freezes the vehicles then shows the start screen.

onRequestMissionScreenData.desc: Hook: when the UI requests the mission screen data (mode not containing 'test'), returns the active screen via onRequestMissionScreenDataReady and emits onMissionScreenReady.

onMissionScreenButtonClicked.desc: Hook: runs the callback of the clicked button (mgrId 'multiseatGamemode'). For the end screen, immediately; for the start screen, after returning to the multiseat route, onUIStartButtonClicked and a 0.1 s delay.

onGetIsMissionStartOrEndScreenActive.desc: Hook: adds the active screen mode to the screensActive list.

onLoadingScreenFadeout.desc: Empty hook: the "vehicles ready" flow of onPreRender already handles the transition.

onAfterRouteChange.desc: Hook after a UI route change: if a start screen is pending and the target route is 'play' or 'multiseat', plays it.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: unblocks the actions, calls ext.stop() and resets all state, including the mode registry.

onPauseHomeRailBuildMultiseatActions.desc: Multiseat pause menu build hook: adds the Game modes button if there is no active mode, otherwise Settings, Quit and Restart mode.

registerButton.desc: Function that registers a button and its callback.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Vehicle switch hook: restarts the mode if in the 'running' phase and outside vehicle synchronization.

onMultiseatSettingsApplied.desc: Hook after multiseat settings are applied: restarts the mode if changeSet.requiresRestart and if the application succeeded without exitAfterApply.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-level hook: stops the mode without reactivating freeroam.
